author: Techlore
description:
Brave just released Brave Origin. A paid, stripped-down version of their browser with no AI, no crypto wallet, no rewards, and no telemetry. I paid $60 to test it live and compare it directly to regular Brave. Linux users get it for free! Is this a legitimate solution to a real problem, or is Brave just charging you to undo their own choices?

description:

This one matters whether you're in the US (Parents Decide Act) or Europe with their open source + Zero Knowledge Proof approach.
